stage: Frozen after request freeze and before any new expansion provider output
human_policy: HR-003 provisional quality/coverage/resources; HR-009 at most 3 fixed anonymized outputs and 10 minutes total, with no substitution

source_expectations.scope: 70 raw-span anchors and 18 boundary/layout notes over 18 primary passages/19 regions; diagnostic AI expectations, not exhaustive references or human gold

scope: Bounded quote-v2 expansion across the 16 remaining primary passages plus 2 controls per Qwen/Gemma model (36 new calls). The 2 already completed quote-v2 primary passages per model are reused by exact request/source/image/model identity, yielding 18 real and 2 control attempts per model. Muse is excluded from this expansion after two observed 120-second timeouts; it remains resource-failure evidence, not a general quality conclusion.
response_contract: quote-v2 exact unique old-source quotes, host derives coordinates; all original source/image/patch guards retained
reuse_policy: The four completed primary requests are not rerun and are not counted as new calls. Their exact request bytes, source/image bindings, model identity, prior attempt IDs and prior assessment hashes are retained. No fallback, offset repair or silent replay is permitted.
control_policy: Each model's missing-image and unrelated-image controls must leave every target unchanged and mark every whole target uncertain. The unrelated-image payload retains its true foreign source bindings. No fabricated source binding or target edit may pass.

excluded.reason: Two observed 120-second timeouts in the quote-v2 diagnostic; excluded from expansion without retry. This is not a model-quality conclusion.

whole_output_assessment: Host validates exact source quotes, host-derived offsets, disjoint edits, target/source-image bindings and preserves all failures; no automatic repair of invalid outputs.
Root compares every proposed changed span to its actual source image, including substitutions, deletions and insertions. Unsupported critical changes fail fidelity.

Root reviews each whole derived passage against the source for omissions, residual OCR damage, names/numbers/negations, speaker/quotation boundaries, accidental neighbor inclusion and truncated endings. Unchecked passages remain ungraded, not passed.
Assess reading flow and pronunciation-relevant text separately from exact fidelity. Preserve historical spelling/grammar; no synthesized speech or listening claim.
Evaluate 70 pre-output anchors on raw, static and derived text using exact source mappings; report as diagnostic anchor outcomes, never full character/word error rate.

Keep every invalid, timeout or unknown case in the 20-attempt model denominator; report the 18 real and 2 control denominators separately. The four reused primary outputs remain in the denominator with their prior assessment.
Controls must preserve every unsupported target unchanged and mark every whole target uncertain; wrong-image payload keeps its true foreign source descriptors. No fabricated source binding.
Freeze each visual assessment with source/image/request/reply hashes and explicit AI reviewer identity before human review.

Human sees only the fixed HR-009 selection, with model names hidden. Do not substitute a successful case for a failed selected output. Stop at 10 minutes or sooner and label remaining outputs AI-only.
acceptance: Only provisional pilot criteria from HR-003; no P0 closure, automatic corpus adoption or full-run authorization. Human unreviewed coverage is always explicit.

human_selection.policy: HR-009 fixed selection; at most 3 anonymized outputs and 10 minutes; no substitution

not_produced.reason: Muse excluded after observed resource timeouts; do not substitute another case

diagnostic_success: Across the completed 18-passage real set, at least one valid replayable source-grounded improvement and no unsupported substantive change, with both controls behaving as specified and every invalid/timeout/unknown retained and reported. This is a bounded pilot assessment, not P0 closure, full-run authorization or a general model ranking.
